checks: Cost correction retains one operational row, original URL/reference, exact revision values and one active Finance version
Cost detail provides current payment, source/recipient, evidence, rates, user and full financial revision history
Unverified supplier advance edits through shared review engine without changing its operational identity
Finance verification locks advances in UI metadata and both shared/legacy direct edit APIs
Allocated advance cannot be edited or reversed even when another advance could cover the supplier pool
Only an uncommitted, dependency-free owned draft can be deleted; recorded advance history remains protected

All six configured same-currency combinations (USD, PKR, KRW, EUR, JPY, CNY) with combined settlements keep native debit, KRW value and one real Finance movement consistent and eligible after verification
Missing foreign valuation, mistaken transfer identity rate and arbitrary KRW valuation are rejected without inventing FX gain/loss
Existing suspect mapping remains unchanged, explicitly blocked with a specific valuation reason while Finance verification is displayed separately
Original-user unposted valuation repair preserves the incorrect historical snapshot, rebuilds correct linked Finance/proposal values and requires re-verification
Import edits commit once with durable result lookup; concurrent retry and lost-response recovery do not duplicate audit/work
Sensitive import authorization preserves edit/CEO reasons, saves atomically once and completes the approval handshake
Ordinary non-CEO sensitive import approval executes its exact stored snapshot once, with current permissions and stale-record checks
Receiving failure rolls back stock/status/Accounting/audit; concurrent keyed retries create one stock receipt and one receipt journal
Supplier statement uses current valid settlements, explicit KRW basis and non-cash allocations without duplicate cash
Every offered statement format actually downloads with correct headers and reconciled CSV/current PDF generation
